title: String Mutability
instructions: Are strings in Kotlin mutable or immutable?

options.text: Mutable — you can change individual characters
Immutable — you cannot change them after creation
It depends on whether you use val or var

explanation: Strings in Kotlin are immutable. Once a string is created, its characters cannot be changed. Using val vs var controls whether the variable can point to a different string, but the string object itself never changes. Functions like .uppercase() return a new string — they do not modify the original.
